reviews.title: Business model is over complicating it
reviews.text: I really want to like it, but the fact that they keep pushing a subscription model at me is so irritating. There’s a way to get past that by choosing gauge mode, but it’s not intuitive at all and it takes me a minute to remember every time I use it. Jesus, I just wanted a reliable housing for my phone. Why over complicate it?

reviews.title: Why is there no redundancy?
reviews.text: So this app relies entirely on the action button to start logging a dive. Should you be on a live aboard dive boat in the middle of the ocean…like me right now…and the action button on your brand new Apple Watch stops working, then this app is totally worthless and you cannot use the watch as a computer. You must press the action button, end of story. Touch screen works just fine and I can touch “start dive” but it then requires you press the action button to start logging the dive..or for it to do anything with this app. Now I’m down to my back up computer alone because I cannot use this one. It’s a Shearwater so I’m not really concerned, but my watch is way more comfortable. Please add a touch screen option or an auto start option. Seems counterintuitive that there’s not already a back up option:(

reviews.title: Pointless useless
reviews.text: Doesn’t even work on Apple Watch Ultra 4, just constantly stuck at this pathetic screen asking me to login from my phone by pressing the sync button in settings. Said sync button literally does nothing except instantaneously say “can’t connect” as if it didn’t even attempt, there is absolutely no way to just do it from the more than capable watch. Just a complete joke how sad technology is allowed to be in 2026.

reviews.title: Can not sync with ultra 2
reviews.text: I tried many times, it just can not sync with my Apple Watch Ultra 2

reviews.title: Possible scam, day plan
reviews.text:
I have had their annual plan for two years with no issue and their monthly plan last year. 

Two weeks ago, I signed up for their daily plan and they charged me twice and refused to refund. 

Buyer beware.

reviews.title: Frustrating software lock and unreliable auto-launch
reviews.text:
Between Apple and Huish Outdoors, this app effectively forms a closed monopoly on the Apple Watch Ultra, forcing divers into an aggressive and expensive subscription model with zero real competition.
To make matters worse, you can't even rely on it when you're on the boat: the heavily advertised auto-launch feature is completely hit-or-miss. Standing at the surface waiting for a critical safety app to trigger shouldn't feel like a gamble. For a setup this expensive, it's unacceptable that basic reliability is secondary to a paywall.

reviews.title: Junk
reviews.text: Total junk, can’t even complete onboarding, just keeps resetting my info and telling me to complete step 1 again. Can’t even figure out how to change the units to something sensible

reviews.title: Not Working
reviews.text:
Just downloaded the app and wanted to try it out before deciding whether to subscribe. Unfortunately, it won’t save my profile information, so I can’t even properly get through the initial setup.

I’m using iOS 27, so this may be a compatibility issue, but it’s a pretty poor first impression for a new user considering a paid subscription. Hopefully this gets fixed soon.

reviews.title: New Update is Awful
reviews.text:
App was fine before the update. Now you have to pay for a subscription to use the basic scuba photo functionality, on top of already paying $400 for the housing. Additionally they’re trying to turn it into a dive computer with all these extra features, but I already have one and absolutely don’t want two of them at once. The new safety stop feature is terrible because it activates even if you’re down for an incredibly short period and have to come back up. It will just continuously beep if you don’t go back down. I don’t think my Shearwater dive computer even started a safety stop it was so quick. No way to disable it in the settings, you can only turn it off mid-dive. 

Devs: I would raise this to 4-5 stars if you made the whole dive watch and logging functionality completely separate, and it can be behind a paywall. But having to pay for a subscription for the camera when we’re already paying $400 is just ridiculous.

reviews.title: Impossible to sync to watch
reviews.text: A new watch, a new app, a new phone. You’d think it would just work. Frustration abounds.

reviews.title: Just awful
reviews.text: Try to set to al80 but it keeps jumping back to al85. Try to sync to watch and it keeps failing even though app on watch and phone are same version and software up to date. Save your money and get a real dive watch. Shame on Apple and OCEANIC. This should be a life support system.

reviews.title: No undo delete
reviews.text: I mistakenly deleted the wrong dive because I had one incorrectly logged dive due to the “automated dive” feature starting a dive prematurely. The dive still shows up on my watch but there is no way to resync it from the watch to the app. There’s also no undo delete option. If I reboot the phone and resync the watch then it will resync briefly, but it then deletes within a minute or two. As a developer, this is clearly just a flag that the app puts in the cloud to not sync that dive again. Allowing people to undo the deletion or storing it in a temporary cache on the device for “n” days is common sense. So now I have an entire dive missing from this app when this would have never happened from a dive computer. Please fix this!

reviews.title: Vibrating Safety Stop Alarm Is a Buzz Kill
reviews.text:
Small annoyances like requiring “fit and ready to dive” acknowledgement.

Major annoyance: Repeated safety stop alarm when repeatedly crossing 20’ depth.

I’ve been using the watch and app as a backup computer, but I’m done with it.

Fix that, and I’ll use it again.

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text:
Frustrating interface. Defaults to 85cf aluminum tank when selecting 80cf.
Stays in ghost mode on my watch.  No interface while diving.

Until glitches are fixed I will not recommend.

reviews.title: Can’t connect to Apple Watch Ultra
reviews.text: Have tried various troubleshooting steps. No error message.

reviews.title: Watch app ok, iPhone app terrible
reviews.text:
The actual dive computer bit works well enough but does require fiddling with (such as pushing the action button) to start or finish a dive.  I guess, ok, that’s a decision they made.  If you don’t hit the action button, it’s supposed to end the dive after 5 minutes at the surface.  But it doesn’t.  It often drags on, showing a depth of 0’ for up to 20 minutes after a dive.

It’s the iPhone companion software that is a hot mess.  Firstly, there is zero documentation, only video tutorials that are lacking in detail and a FAQ that is grossly out of date.

Here is just a sampling of issues:

* On the Location Planner the weather is always laughably incorrect for my location.
* On the Location Planner water temps appear incorrect for my location as well.  If appears to be due to the assumption of a “geo fence” of 50 miles or so around a point.  That works for oceans, not really for local lakes and rivers.
* Under Dive Settings the air pressure sliders don’t match displayed amounts.
* The times in the Dynamic Island often out of sync with the app and watch.
* On the Share Screen the “minimum temperature” appears to be the average temperature.
* On my last dive it showed the entry point 2 miles off.  The exit point is useless as one never knows when it will end the dive.  I’ve had my exit point be the local dive shop 🤣.
* The ascent rate seems to always be abnormally high at the end of the dive (last 3’). It seems to be picking up me raising up my arm at the end of the ascent.  All

reviews.title: Love the watch don’t love Diving with it
reviews.text:
I purchased the Apple Watch as my backup computer. I am a dive master and have been diving for years. I had heard a lot about the Apple Watch for Diving and wanted to give it a try.  I also had my Garmin watch on as my main computer. 
The algorithms are completely off on this app  I was on a weeklong Diving vacation in Cozumel. 
On my first dive , the computer started freaking out telling me that I needed to do a decompression stop. This was completely incorrect.
It did result in me getting locked out of my Apple Dive computer for two days. Even though it was incorrect, I was unable to reset it or use again. 
I think there needs to be a lot of work done on the algorithms on this app to make an an effective die of computer for recreational Diving.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Completely useless. Wasted about 5 hours trying to get the account to sync to the watch. Paid the subscription but could not use it even once as the account simply would sync to the watch. The one dive I performed was stuck in snorkelling mode as a result so it did not calculate decompression stops. Total waste of money. Extremely disappointed. I want a refund.

reviews.title: Backup at best
reviews.text:
I decided to continue using this as my (fortunately) backup dive computer for my 10+ day dive trip. 
At first, setup was next to impossible requiring the app to be reinstalled several times. 
Then, the first day only 2/3 dives uploaded. But I continued to use it since I already paid & was pretty satisfied with how it continued to function for the rest of the week. And it seemed to correctly upload the logbook (although it never showed a successful sync since it just kept saying to open the app on the watch no matter how many times I reopened it or tried to sync when it was already open). 
But forward to today, I jump in the water & my watch will not start to track the dive with oceanic+ as it did every other day & instead defaulted to depth. Before going down to begin the dive I attempted to open the app etc. which it did without any issues but it still would not start tracking the dive. Or show up as an option. 
And of course as diving is often in the middle of nowhere with no service there was no way to reinstall the app so I could use it for any dives for the rest of the day. 
Had I been relying on this as my primary computer I would have been forced to skip at least a day of diving or risk serious injury. 

I will not be using this as a primary computer nor do I recommend it. It is very unreliable.

reviews.title: Close, but not there yet
reviews.text:
EDIT: UGG!!  Somehow switched to snorkeling mode at the beginning of a dive. That disabled dive mode for 24 hours. So you have to literally keep the watch out of the water for 24hrs to use it for diving again. That pretty much renders the whole thing useless as a backup or primary. This is really unacceptable. There needs to be some kind of lockout, override or mode change verification.  Reducing to 1 Star until that is resolved. 

Prior post: the I’ve used it as a backup for many dives at this point. Just upgraded to version 2 and disappointed to see that the log book still does not sync and it still tacks the 5 minute surface timeout to the logged dive time. I did not get the nuisance rapid ascent warning from lifting my LPI like the old version, but it still registered a max rate of 133ft/min. I’m not sure how other computers deal with this, but my Shearwater, Sherwood and AL’s don’t do it. Also, I’ll add my +1 that without Air Integration, this is not much more than a novelty considering the hardware and subscription costs. 

On the upside it is very easy to use and set gasses. It has become my go-to compass. When I’m teaching, I wear it as a backup computer and primary compass - although I find myself wishing for a rose/rotating bezel or pointer for quick reference. 

Still a little squirrelly on the surface. The ‘fit and ready to dive’ disclaimer is kind of silly. If you have a PIN lock and wear it over a wetsuit, you might find yourself descending with an unlockable Lo

reviews.title: Doesn’t work offline
reviews.text:
I got the app the day it came out and I was on my way to dive in Papua New Guinea. Unfortunately, every time it tried to open the app on my phone to download my dives, it kept crashing. I had no cell service for 10 days. Back in the states now but frustrated that I couldn’t download my dives while offline. I also hate that you have to confirm that you are “fit to dive”. The dive should record as soon as you hit the water. Many times I forgot to confirm. Also, the app will not synch all the dives on my watch. I did 19 dives and they are on the watch log but the app only says 8 dives. I even tried to manually sync but they don’t show up. Too many bugs.

Update: now using the newest update in Indonesia. When I start a dive, it automatically goes into water lock and I can’t confirm that  fit to dive. Now all my dives are “ghost dives”. Very annoying.

New update 2025: diving in Indonesia and the camera locks every time I switch from camera to video. Won’t switch back. Very annoying. I can’t use it for the rest of the dive.
